Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for Max and Mia. Your postal code gets the residents-first date, which is this one, and the general public opens 7 days later. Registration page: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026

Max fits the published age band. Mia is just outside it, within the margin for an approximate birthday, so check that her age fits before you pick a class.

Hale never registers for you. Here is what I will send, in order: a week-ahead note on Tuesday, September 8. A checklist 3 days before, on Saturday, September 12. An evening-before reminder on Monday, September 14. And a just-before-open note 15 minutes ahead, at 6:45 a.m. on the 15th.

Once you pick a course, you can send me its page and the morning text will carry the link.
